summary: The current manifest binds the support agent directly to the existing implementation symbols and records the dynamic tool registry relationship as an agent-level warning. Runner-owned validation passed, including inspection and TypeScript checking, and the workspace evidence limits the actor change to moldea/moldea.yaml.

requirements.evidence: moldea/moldea.yaml binds runtimeAgent, instructionLoader, and outputSchema to /src/support-assistant.ts symbols supportAssistant, loadSupportInstruction, and SupportOutputSchema. src/support-assistant.ts exports all three symbols, while the removed src/support-agent.ts path is absent and unreferenced. Deterministic inspection and validation were valid, typecheck passed, and workspace assertions identify moldea/moldea.yaml as the sole actor-changed path.

moldea/moldea.yaml contains agent-owned unresolved requirement dynamic-tool-registry-relationship with effect warning, explains that static inspection cannot establish whether assembleTools supplies supportAssistant, gives concrete resolution criteria using closed runtime wiring or an integration test, and relates /src/dynamic-tools.ts#assembleTools and /src/support-assistant.ts#supportAssistant. No tool binding was invented; src/dynamic-tools.ts only defines dynamic registry assembly, and supportAssistant currently declares no tools argument.
